title: A Hybrid Decision Tree and Deep Learning Approach Combining Medical Imaging and Electronic Medical Records to Predict Intubation Among Hospitalized Patients With COVID-19: Algorithm Development and Validation
summary: A hybrid imaging and electronic-record model predicted intubation among hospitalized patients with COVID-19; the paper reports internal and external validation. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
